$description: Source and test files (.js .mjs .cjs .jsx .ts .tsx .rs) over `limit` tokens (bytes / 4 of the staged file), at their recorded sizes. Such a file may not grow, and no other file may pass the limit. `exempt`: generated or vendored files, each with its reason. Lower with `node scripts/check-file-size.mjs --update` in its own commit. See scripts/check-file-size.mjs.
